name: VAT return (IRS217)
legal_reference: FRCS Value Added Tax Return, form IRS217: thirteen boxes in three steps — output tax (1 to 6), input tax (7 to 12) and the amount to pay or refund (13). The return is filed monthly above FJ$300,000 of annual gross turnover, three-monthly or yearly below (VAT Guide, chapter 10). The form is VAT-inclusive on the sales side: box 1 and box 3 are totals here (exclusive base plus tax) and the exclusive figures sit in the boxes 2 and 3a. Boxes 5, 9 and 11 (adjustments, apportionment) are the preparer's: declared and empty.

deadline.legal_reference: Section 33 of the VAT Act as quoted by FRCS — the return is due on or before the last day of the month following the last day of every taxable period: January 2025 monthly return by 28 February 2025; January–March 2024 quarter by 30 April 2024; calendar year 2023 by 31 January 2024 (VAT Guide, chapter 10). Payment is due with the return.

boxes.name: Box 1 — Total taxable supplies for the period (VAT included, zero-rated supplies included)
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 1 — the total taxable supplies of the period including VAT and the zero-rated supplies; exempt supplies are not in it. Here box 2 plus box 3.

boxes.name: Box 2 — Zero-rated supplies included in box 1
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 2 — the zero-rated supplies of the period, included in box 1 (exports and the other zero-rated supplies).

boxes.name: Box 3 — Supplies subject to VAT (box 1 less box 2, VAT included)
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 3 — box 1 less box 2, the supplies charged with VAT, VAT included. Here the exclusive base of box 3a plus the VAT of box 4.

boxes.name: Box 3a — Supplies subject to VAT, VAT excluded
boxes.legal_reference: Not a box of the form: the exclusive value of the supplies of box 3, which the engine posts and from which box 3 is rebuilt.

boxes.name: Box 4 — VAT charged by you (box 3 × tax fraction)
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 4 — box 3 multiplied by the tax fraction: 1/9 at 12.5 % (FRCS rate table), 3/23 at 15 %.

boxes.name: Box 5 — VAT on output adjustments
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 5 and panel 1 — goods and services taken for private use, bartered, given as fringe benefits, bad debts recovered, debit notes issued, credit notes received and the like. Declared and empty: an adjustment is a decision of the preparer, no tax code posts to it.

boxes.name: Box 6 — Total output tax (box 4 plus box 5)
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 6 — the total VAT charged on taxable supplies.

boxes.name: Box 7 — Purchases and expenses, VAT excluded (basis of box 7)
boxes.legal_reference: The purchases on which the VAT of box 7 is claimed; the form asks for the VAT only, the value is kept for the reader.

boxes.name: Box 7 — Total VAT on purchases and expenses (tax invoicing requirements met, imports excluded)
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 7 — the VAT of the input tax schedule, which must meet the invoicing requirements; it excludes imported goods.

boxes.name: Box 8 — Imports, customs value (basis of box 8)
boxes.legal_reference: The imported goods whose VAT is claimed in box 8; the form asks for the VAT only.

boxes.name: Box 8 — Total VAT paid to or invoiced by Customs for imports
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 8 — the VAT invoiced by Customs on goods imported under the business's name and used in the business.

boxes.name: Box 9 — VAT on input adjustments
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 9 and panel 2 — bad debts written off, credit notes issued, debit notes received and the VAT refundable on a change of accounting basis. Declared and empty, for the reason given at box 5.

boxes.name: Box 10 — Total VAT on purchases, credit adjustments and expenses (boxes 7 + 8 + 9)
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 10 — boxes 7, 8 and 9 added.

boxes.name: Box 11 — VAT on purchases not wholly used in making taxable supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 11 and panel 3 — the part of the input tax that matches the supplies not subject to VAT, unless those are 5 % of the supplies or FJ$4,000 at most, whichever is less. Declared and empty: the apportionment is a decision of the preparer.

boxes.name: Box 12 — Total VAT incurred on taxable purchases (box 10 less box 11)
Box 13 — Amount to pay (positive) or refund due (negative) (box 6 less box 12)
boxes.legal_reference: Form IRS217, box 13 — box 6 less box 12: positive is VAT payable, negative is the refund due. An amount under FJ$5 is not remitted and not refunded (instructions), a rule the engine does not apply.
